intro.text: A young Arelene boy taken by the Shaod, who lives at the Roost in New Elantris under Matisse's care.

items.text: When Raoden founded New Elantris, Tiil and about fifty other children were put in Matisse's care at the Roost, where she taught them to draw Aons.

When Fjordell soldiers attacked Elantris, Matisse enlisted Tiil and Teor to keep the little ones quiet and on the move. She told them that, as her father was a soldier, she was one too, and they could be her subcaptains if they followed her orders.
